RC Surface 1.0.2 makes the phone light again with the camera on. Hand tracking moves off the phone's interface thread, the VID page gives the camera most of the screen, and STAGE no longer gets stuck when the browser leaves fullscreen. Requirements are unchanged, and your mappings, presets, learned poses and the two Max for Live devices carry over from 1.0.1.

> Em português: [Guia do usuário](https://github.com/ntworm/rc-surface/blob/main/docs/USER-GUIDE.pt-BR.md) · [Instalação](https://github.com/ntworm/rc-surface/blob/main/docs/INSTALL.pt-BR.md) · [FAQ](https://github.com/ntworm/rc-surface/blob/main/docs/FAQ.pt-BR.md) · [Página em português](https://ntworm.github.io/rc-surface/pt-br.html)

## What changed since 1.0.1

### A lighter phone with the camera on

- On a phone or tablet, hand tracking runs in a background worker. Before, every MediaPipe inference held the phone's interface for its whole duration, so with the camera on the entire UI repainted only as fast as frames were analysed (21 FPS on the test phone). Touch, buttons and the other pages now stay responsive while the camera runs.
- The phone preview is the live camera image, smooth at the camera's own rate. The hand skeleton is no longer drawn on phones: it always trailed the live picture. Detection, poses and every vision mapping work as before.
- On a computer with a mouse the preview is unchanged: the analysed frame with the hand drawn on top, in sync.
- The Live panel's **MediaPipe Latency** shows `worker` or `main thread` next to the time. A browser without worker support, or a worker that fails, tracks on the page as in 1.0.1.

### A bigger camera on VID

- Held sideways, the camera fills the left side at the full height (on the test phone, 433×325 instead of 303×228).
- Camera, CONF and REC, the three learned poses as one-line rows (CAPTURE, TEST, DELETE LAST, CLR, with their status line), the detectors and the MAP/CLUTCH readouts sit in the column on the right. Every label fits in English and Portuguese down to 568 px wide.
- Tablets and desktop keep the previous arrangement.

### Fixes

- **STAGE** followed only its own button. Leaving fullscreen with the back gesture, or through a camera or microphone permission prompt, left the page in stage mode with an EXIT button and no fullscreen. Stage mode now ends with fullscreen, as the user guide describes, and its exit label is translated (EXIT / SAIR).

### Site and docs

- The landing page's VID plan view shows the new layout; the masthead, search metadata and social card read v1.0.2.
- The User Guide in English and Portuguese describes the phone and desktop previews and the STAGE behaviour. The full list is in the [changelog](https://github.com/ntworm/rc-surface/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md).

## Upgrading from 1.0.1

1. Download `RC-Surface-1.0.2.ablx` below and install it the same way as before (double-click, then restart Live if it was running). The data folder stays `worm.rc-surface`.
2. Reload the controller page on the phone.
3. `RC-Midi-Receiver.amxd` and `RC-Audio-Sender.amxd` are the same files as in 1.0.1 (Receiver v2.2, Audio Sender v2). Nothing to replace in your Sets.
4. Coming from 0.x or a pre-1.0 candidate, follow the 1.0.0 steps first: run the data migrator from the kit and replace old Receivers with v2.2.
5. `SHA256SUMS.txt` lists the checksums of the three attached files.

## Requirements

Unchanged: Ableton Live 12.4.5+ Suite (Beta) with the Extensions SDK host, Max for Live for the two devices, a phone with a current browser on the same Wi-Fi. [AbletonOSC](https://github.com/ideoforms/AbletonOSC) stays optional; Next Beat and Bar need it and Live playing.

## Tested

The maintainer accepted the changes on an Android phone in Chrome and on a desktop browser before release: a lighter and more responsive phone with the camera on, pose detection, the new VID layout and the desktop preview. The automated suites (unit, UI in desktop and mobile Chromium, and the CI build on Windows, macOS and Linux) pass. Trigger Note, mapping presets, Panic and disconnection were not re-tested on hardware in this cycle; macOS and Safari/iOS remain untested on stage, as in 1.0.1.

## Known limitations

- Phones do not draw the hand skeleton. The preview mode follows the device's primary input: a touch-first device shows the live camera, a mouse-first computer shows the drawn hand.
- The background worker needs `OffscreenCanvas` with WebGL. Older browsers, including iOS before 17, track on the page as in 1.0.1.
- Turning the camera or microphone on while STAGE is fullscreen can still make Chrome leave fullscreen; stage mode now ends with it. Enable audio and camera before entering STAGE when possible.
- One controller at a time: the phone and the desktop client on the same surface at once produce inconsistent state.
- Learned poses belong to the hand that taught them.
